row.proto: int Game_SaveSlotManager_SelectSlot(void *manager, uint64_t slot_id, bool force, uint32_t a4)
row.notes: Loads a career slot by id: finds the SaveSlotInfo in manager+0x268..+0x270 whose +0x0 slot_id equals slot_id (0x22 if none; 0x25 if already current and not force), serialises the current slot (+0x280) with 0x1429ce380, stores the new slot at +0x280 (site_Game_SaveSlot_Selected), and if its blob (+0x178) is set deserialises it with 0x1429d1270, restoring the old current slot on failure (0x1429d0c6a). An empty blob logs 'Load postponed due to empty data. Slot %s : %d.' Callers: census steam 0x29d0b90.

verify.notes: V1470 proto checked: rdx compared with the slot's qword +0 (u64 slot_id), r8b tested (bool force), r9d passed on as r8d to 0x1429ce380 (u32); returns 0x22 none, 0x25 same slot without force.
V2878 decomp checked: offsets/calls/strings match claim
